description: Use when the user wants to "make a video/clip", "generate a video from text", "animate this image/photo", "create a marketing reel / social video / teaser", "do a 3D / parallax move", "pan/zoom/orbit a shot", or mentions fal.ai, Kling, Veo or Seedance for video. Staged fal.ai workflow — brainstorm, draft cheaply, produce the final at quality. Three modes: text-to-video, animate (still to motion), camera-move (push-in/pan/orbit). Not for still images (image-studio), slide decks, or charts. Honesty discipline: never depict real identifiable subjects via text-to-video.
